primary.title: Claiming both HRA exemption and home loan interest deduction: Know when it is allowed — and when it's not
primary.summary: Claiming HRA along with home loan benefits is allowed in certain situations, but mismatches in rent, property status, or loan details can attract tax notices. Here’s what taxpayers should know about location rules, eligibility, and documentation.
